exact: venom-mediated suppression of blood coagulation cascade, contact activation system

definition: A process in which an organism inhibits or disrupts blood coagulation in another organism by suppression of the intrinsic pathway via the action of a venom. A common mechanism is the blocking the activity of host coagulation Factor XIIa (F12).
label: venom-mediated suppression of blood coagulation, intrinsic pathway
